tool_args.query:
SELECT 
    city, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.gmap_id) as restaurant_count,
    SUM(e.critical_violation_count) as total_critical_violations
FROM establishments e
WHERE e.critical_violation_count >= 1
GROUP BY city
ORDER BY restaurant_count DESC
LIMIT 15;

SELECT 
    ek.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.gmap_id) as establishment_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) as total_inspections,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as critical_violation_citations
FROM establishments e
JOIN establishment_keys ek ON e.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE vc.critical = TRUE
GROUP BY ek.city
ORDER BY establishment_count DESC;

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.gmap_id) as total_matched_establishments,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN vc.critical = TRUE THEN e.gmap_id END) as establishments_with_critical_violations
FROM establishments e
JOIN establishment_keys ek ON e.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
LEFT JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
LEFT JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
LEFT JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id;

SELECT 
    ek.city,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.gmap_id) as establishment_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.inspection_id) as total_inspections,
    COUNT(v.violation_id) as critical_violation_citations
FROM establishments e
JOIN establishment_keys ek ON e.slchd_establishment_key = ek.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN inspections i ON ek.slchd_establishment_key = i.slchd_establishment_key
JOIN violations v ON i.inspection_id = v.inspection_id
JOIN violation_codes vc ON v.violation_code_id = vc.violation_code_id
WHERE vc.critical = TRUE
